info.title: OpenStackID API
info.description: OpenStackID IDP API Documentation - OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and User Management

get.description: Retrieves user details by their numeric ID.

403.description: Forbidden - Only service accounts are allowed

get.description: Initiates an OAuth2 authorization flow. Supports Authorization Code, Implicit, Hybrid, and OpenID Connect flows. Per RFC 6749 §3.1, GET is required.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: Redirect URI (must match a registered URI)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque state parameter returned in the redirect

parameters.name: nonce
parameters.description: Nonce for ID token replay protection (OIDC)

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Space-delimited user interaction prompts (OIDC). Allowed tokens: none, login, consent, select_account. "none" cannot be combined with others. Example: "login consent"

200.description: Authorization request processed (response in body), depends on "response_mode" param

302.description: Redirect to client redirect_uri with authorization code, tokens, or error

put.description: Initiates an OAuth2 authorization flow via PUT. Same parameters as GET but sent as form data.

200.description: Authorization request processed (response in body), depends on "response_mode" param

302.description: Redirect to client redirect_uri with authorization code, tokens, or error

post.description: Initiates an OAuth2 authorization flow via POST. Same parameters as GET but sent as form data.

200.description: Authorization request processed (response in body), depends on "response_mode" param

302.description: Redirect to client redirect_uri with authorization code, tokens, or error

delete.description: Initiates an OAuth2 authorization flow via DELETE. Same parameters as GET but sent as form data.

200.description: Authorization request processed (response in body), depends on "response_mode" param

302.description: Redirect to client redirect_uri with authorization code, tokens, or error

patch.description: Initiates an OAuth2 authorization flow via PATCH. Same parameters as GET but sent as form data.

200.description: Authorization request processed (response in body), depends on "response_mode" param

302.description: Redirect to client redirect_uri with authorization code, tokens, or error

post.description: Issues access tokens. Supports authorization_code, client_credentials, password, refresh_token, and passwordless grant types.
Revokes an access token or refresh token per RFC 7009. The endpoint is idempotent — revoking a non-existent token returns success.
Validates and returns metadata about an access token per RFC 7662. Returns detailed information about the token including associated user data.

get.description: Returns the OpenID Provider JSON Web Key Set document containing public keys used for signing tokens (RFC 7517).
Returns the OpenID Provider Configuration document per OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0.
Returns the OpenID Provider Configuration document per OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0.
Initiates RP-Initiated Logout per OpenID Connect Session Management 1.0. Terminates the user session and optionally redirects to the post-logout URI.

parameters.description: URI to redirect after logout (must be registered)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque state parameter returned in the redirect

user_email_verified.description: Whether the user email is verified
